dialogues.speaker: Furuta
dialogues.text: Indeed, and the most capable housekeeper in this mansion would be Thoma.

dialogues.speaker: Furuta
dialogues.text: Whether it is trimming the courtyard, collecting furnishings, cooking, or sewing, Thoma can do them all nicely and quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Furuta
dialogues.text: It's almost a shame that he also needs to serve the Commissioner and Miss Kamisato, so he can't take care of everything.

dialogues.speaker: Furuta
dialogues.text: As long he is around, the Kamisato Clan has no need of servants. Hahaha...
